_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7 $FE88-$FECB: the enemy stat scaling by area. The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Difficulty scaling (slot $C162): start
regions.description: ENEMY STAT SCALING BY AREA (slot `$C162`, called by most enemy handlers when they are made): `$50` is the labyrinth area, or in a corridor the corridor folded onto 1-10. `$50` = 0 goes to the three halvings; otherwise A := (`$50` + 1) / 2 (1 for areas 1-2, 2 for 3-4, 3 for 5-6, 4 for 7-8, 5 for 9-10).

regions.name: Difficulty scaling: halve
regions.description: Y := A (0 for area 0), then three minus A times: attack `$05A8,X` and hit points `$0590,X` are halved (never below 1). A = 3 returns unchanged (`$FEB0`); A of 4 or more goes to the doubling. RUN: from (64, 64): area 0 -> 8, areas 1-2 -> 16, areas 3-4 -> 32.

regions.name: Difficulty scaling: double
regions.description: A - 3 times: attack and hit points are doubled, capped at `$FF`. RUN: areas 5-6 -> 64 (unchanged), 7-8 -> 128, 9-10 -> 255 (4 times, capped). So an enemy's strength runs 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4 times its table value across the areas.
